name: save-boot-4-party-barret-menu
description: #101: Barret in party slot 1, in the field menu (the menu draws party HP, as #78's reactor-mode-2e). Boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-barret.json: #38's md1stin boot point with party Cloud, Barret, empty (author-chosen). Load as save-boot-1-load does: from the title, Circle every 30 frames until field mode, then #77's field-loaded rule; the field is md1stin (116). Then Triangle (4 frames every second) until g_GameState reads menu (5; menu_wait), and 30 frames more. Savemap partyID reads Cloud (0x00), Barret (0x01), empty (0xFF); g_ActiveCharacters[1] has current and max HP in 1..9999. At the end, g_ActiveCharacters[1] holds a Barret weapon (equipMask 0x0002; w1_barret) and g_ActiveCharacters[0] a Cloud weapon (0x0201): #129 replaces the raw id byte at + 0 (act_id1, 0 for every character in #101) with a field that tells the characters apart. Otherwise only 1/0 leaves. match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state.
